text:
sam: quick sync — pulling together owners/dates for INC-482 postmortem actions. infra is swamped this week so i'm proposing a small rebalance of the action queue. please ack and confirm realistic due dates.

sam: current items copied from the RCA:
```
A1: fix KV cache eviction bug (root cause) — owner: infra-team (unassigned) — target: 2025-03-10
A2: add metric for prefix-cache hit rate — owner: eng-platform (unassigned) — target: 2025-03-05
A3: rollback fallback throttling change that triggered surge — owner: serving-runtime (unassigned) — target: 2025-03-04
A4: add canary + SLA check to deploy pipeline — owner: eng-sre (unassigned) — target: 2025-03-12
A5: postmortem writeup + customer impact note — owner: product-support (unassigned) — target: 2025-03-03
```

sam: proposal (small rebalance): A1 -> kevin (infra), A2 -> anya (eng-platform), A3 -> lina (serving-runtime), A4 -> mira (eng-sre lead), A5 -> sam (prod-support lead)

anya: ack, i can take A2 but need until 2025-03-07 (got a rollout Tues/Wed). that metric needs a short design review first.

kevin: i can pick up A1 but heads up — GPU infra patching on 3/5-3/6. target 2025-03-11 for me. if it's blocking we can gate with a config flag.

lina: i can do A3 but need to coordinate with runtime tests. 2025-03-06 looks reasonable. will open a PR and tag @kevin for config gating.

mira: for A4, eng-sre can add the canary by 2025-03-12 as proposed, but we need sign-off from security for the pipeline change. i'll ping security in a follow-up.

sam: noted. i'll own A5 and aim for 2025-03-04 (consolidated timeline + customer note).

kevin: quick question — who owns the rollout gates for the fallback throttle toggle? want to make sure we don't flip it mid-day.

lina: that should be serving-runtime + eng-sre. i'll coordinate a short window and add a rollback play in the PR.

anya: i'll schedule the design review for A2 on Mon 3/3; will add agenda + short prompt set to test the metric.

mira: security: @security-ops, can you give a quick review for pipeline change? if they can sign off by 3/9 we hit our dates.

ops-bot: Reminder: INC-482 actions due soon. 3 open items assigned within the last 24h. Use /inc action update to change owners or dates.

sam: thanks everyone — summary update i'll drop into the RCA doc and mark the new owners/dates. if anything changes update the RCA or ping here. :thumbsup:

kevin: adding one FYI — i'll block 2 hours on 3/10 for validation post-fix.

anya: good call, i'll add test asserts to the metric PR to make validation quick.

mira: i'll follow up with security and post the sign-off here.

sam: closing the loop — owners: A1=kevin (due 2025-03-11), A2=anya (due 2025-03-07), A3=lina (due 2025-03-06), A4=mira (due 2025-03-12), A5=sam (due 2025-03-04). if no objections i'll update the RCA doc in ~1h.

lina: no objections from me.

kevin: same.

anya: clear.

mira: 👍
